scope: F_1layer int10 HLS core, transformer_top.cpp, SEQ=1024, xc7z020clg400-1, 10 ns
method: analytical cycle model from loop structure + pragmas, reconciled to the one measured top-level latency

measured.note: This is the only measured latency available on this machine; per-function HLS latencies were not regenerated (Vitis HLS not installed here).

residual_attribution: runtime integer division in softmax normalization (qattn = numerator/denom, variable denominator; a 32-bit divider does not pipeline at II=1 on this device)
pipeline fill/drain across the many short per-token inner loops (context restarts the j-pipeline HD times per head in the baseline)
per-token module handshake / control overhead (finish_token is INLINE off)

headline_finding.text: In MAC COUNT scores and context are symmetric (33,554,432 each, 88.58% combined). In CYCLES they are NOT: the score loop unrolls the HD=8 dot product (8 MAC/cyc) while the baseline context loop does not (1 MAC/cyc), so context costs 8x more cycles than scores.
headline_finding.evidence_label: ANALYTICAL estimate: the 45.19% is the modelled context-loop cycle count normalized against the MEASURED total latency (74,246,781 cycles). It is NOT a directly measured per-function HLS latency (Vitis does not emit a bounded per-function latency for the baseline top).

optimization_projection.change: context accumulation restructured to j-outer / HD-unrolled (bit-exact), v cyclic-partitioned factor 8
optimization_projection.functional_status: bit-exact vs baseline: verified by g++ C-simulation on 16/16 golden vectors (byte-identical logits); ap_int csim + csynth still PENDING on laptop
optimization_projection.note: PROJECTION ONLY. Speedup and throughput must be MEASURED by csynth (run_top_opt_verify_and_synth.tcl). Even the optimistic projection stays well below the 48.83 wps continuous non-overlapping input rate; this optimization is necessary but not sufficient for real-time.
optimization_projection.evidence_label: PROJECTION made before synthesis. Superseded for latency by measurement: the MEASURED speedup 2.007x lies inside the projected 1.654-2.358x range. However the projection's implicit assumption that the optimized core would fit Z7020 was FALSE -- see measured_update.

corrected_summary_json_note.impact: immaterial (both round to 88.58%); flagged for correction
